blinding: Read manifest and original frontier assessments; did not read predictions.json, predictor outputs, model labels, or pilot reports. No Laya predictions used for adjudication.
rubric: Label changed Go functions review when their changed behavior affects access/tenant/object authorization, a disclosure boundary, executable capability or effect-ceiling enforcement, identity isolation, or directly asserts one of those invariants in a test (including extracted assertion helpers). Label generic plumbing, fixture setup, test doubles, pure serialization, effect accounting, evidence-integrity checks, and happy-path retry tests routine unless their changed behavior itself implements or asserts such a boundary. Supporting a security test or living in a security package alone is insufficient. Label unknown when the causal link cannot be resolved from pinned source and inspected caller context. Relevance is not a defect finding; routine is only out of scope for this authorization task and does not mean safe to omit from every review.
label_universe: All 93 changed Go functions in pilot-v1 manifest, including functions ineligible for local inference. Nonfunction units excluded.
truth_limitations: Agent adjudication of task relevance, not confirmed vulnerability or fault truth.
No tests invented or executed during adjudication. Existing assertions were inspected as source.
Single adjudicator using prior reviewer proposals; not a third statistically independent blind assessment.
Labels were refined on this cohort, so it remains development data and cannot establish held-out model viability.
Routine labels allow authorization-task triage only; broader fault review remains out of scope.

top_5_ambiguity_patterns.pattern: Fixture proximity versus direct boundary assertion
top_5_ambiguity_patterns.resolution: Generic setup/error-injection helpers are routine; an extracted helper asserting no writes after unauthorized completion remains review.
EffectPossible bookkeeping and successful output persistence are routine; changed ceiling checks and claim/principal fences are review.

top_5_ambiguity_patterns.pattern: Provenance integrity versus authorization identity isolation
top_5_ambiguity_patterns.resolution: Nonzero fingerprint or snapshot-pin checks alone are routine; refusing another principal and preventing disclosure are review.

top_5_ambiguity_patterns.pattern: Serializer versus source of disclosure policy
top_5_ambiguity_patterns.resolution: writeHealth is routine after checking all callers pass fixed literals; the unauthenticated handler, listener exposure and no-state tests are review.
Replay equality is routine; refusing another worker or canceled/stale claims directly exercises the authority to mutate or disclose the record and is review.
